title: MetaCtrl: Your Large Language Models Can Reason Better and More Concisely with a Metacognitive Controller
abstract: arXiv:2609.37304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large reasoning models improve performance on challenging problems by allocating additional computation before answering, but longer reasoning does not always lead to better results and can introduce substantial redundant reasoning on simple problems. Conversely, aggressively shortening reasoning can degrade performance on difficult ones. Effective reasoning therefore requires dynamically deciding when additional computation is useful based on the reasoner's capabilities and evolving solution state. Existing approaches often rely on predefined budgets or intervention rules, retrain the target reasoner, or require additional supervision. We introduce MetaCtrl, a lightweight controller that adaptively regulates a frozen reasoner without predefined token budgets or reasoner retraining. translated_title: MetaCtrl：你的大语言模型可以通过元认知控制器进行更好、更简洁的推理
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型通过在回答前分配额外的计算来提升在具有挑战性问题上的表现，但更长的推理并不总是带来更好的结果，并且在简单问题上可能引入大量冗余推理。相反，激进地缩短推理又会降低在困难问题上的性能。因此，有效的推理需要根据推理器自身的能力和不断演变的求解状态，动态决定何时进行额外计算是有益的。现有方法通常依赖于预定义的预算或干预规则、需要重新训练目标推理器，或需要额外的监督。我们提出了MetaCtrl，一个轻量级控制器，它能够在没有预定义token预算、也无需重新训练推理器的情况下，自适应地调节一个冻结的推理器。我们将推理调节形式化为一个序列化的元认知控制问题：MetaCtrl观察不断演变的推理轨迹，并决定是否继续……
tldr: MetaCtrl提出了一种轻量级元认知控制器，无需预定义token预算或重新训练，即可自适应地调节冻结的大语言模型推理器，使其在简单问题上推理更简洁、在困难问题上推理更充分。
en_tdlr: MetaCtrl is a lightweight metacognitive controller that adaptively regulates a frozen large language model reasoner without predefined token budgets or retraining, enabling more concise reasoning on easy problems and more thorough reasoning on difficult ones.
